He is a 2.03 m tall [[small forward]]. ==Professional career== On April 16, 2015, Čančar signed a five-year contract with [[KK Union Olimpija|Union Olimpija]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/slovenia/158538/olimpija-ljubljana-signs-vlatko-cancar-to-a-5-year-contract.html Olimpija Ljubljana signs Vlatko Cancar to a 5-year contract.] On June 30, 2016, he left Olimpija and signed with Serbian team [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Leks]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/adriatic-league/204223/mega-leks-signs-slovenian-prospect-vlatko-cancar.html Mega Leks signs Slovenian prospect Vlatko Cancar.] On April 2017, Čančar put his name in the pool for the [[2017 NBA Draft]].
